name: Super-Dragon Engineering Plastics Co., Ltd
summary: Based in China, this company specializes in the production and sale of a broad spectrum of advanced plastic and polymer materials. Its comprehensive portfolio includes modified plastics, engineering plastics, specialized engineering plastics, thermoplastics, and functional polymers. Specific product lines encompass modified polypropylene (PP), modified polycarbonate/acrylonitrile butadiene styrene (PC/ABS), modified polyamides (PA), modified polybutylene terephthalate (PBT), modified acrylonitrile butadiene styrene (ABS), and modified high-impact polystyrene (HIPS), among others. These versatile materials find widespread application in diverse sectors such as automotive manufacturing, domestic appliances, telecommunications, electrical apparatus, medical provisions, lighting solutions (e.g., for bathrooms), office machinery, and emerging new energy applications. The firm was established in 1998 and operates from its headquarters in Conghua, China.
